newsitem.title: UK: Watmoughs warns on H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Watmoughs warns on H1 profits.

text.p: British printing firm Watmoughs (Holdings) Plc said on Tuesday that it was unlikely that its underlying first-half profits would match the first half of 1996.
The company told shareholders at its annual general meeting it still believed the group would make "satisfactory progress" in the second half of the year.

Chairman Patrick Walker said, "Our United Kingdom gravure operations are suffering from the continuing strength of the pound which is affecting both our exports and our non-contractual gravure business, as this competes in a European market."
It said the situation was being compounded by the fact that paper is cheaper in Europe than in the UK.
